input: One copied, bounded BAR type9 entry including the 144-byte runtime prefix, or an explicitly selected payload excluding that prefix.

prototype0.initialChannels: Scale at +0/+4/+8, Euler rotation at +16/+20/+24, translation at +32/+36/+40.
prototype0.curveIndices: Nine signed Int32 indices at +48 through +80. -1 retains the initial channel; other negative values are rejected.
prototype0.timeCount: Signed Int32 at payload+32; positive and bounded.
prototype0.curveTables: Unsigned payload offsets +48/+56 with nonnegative signed counts +52/+60, proved by the two stride6 loops in1DAD10. Both full declared spans and the combined root-reference index are bounded.
prototype0.curveRecord: Flags byte+2: low nibble channel; bits4..5 pre-mode; bits6..7 post-mode. Byte+3 positive key count; UInt16+4 first key.
prototype0.tables: UInt32 offsets at +64 keys, +68 times, +72 values, +76 tangents. Key stride8: UInt16 packed timeIndex<<2|mode, valueIndex, inTangentIndex, outTangentIndex.
prototype0.ordering: Global finite times may be equal but cannot decrease. Referenced keys require strictly increasing indices and strictly increasing finite times. This intentionally excludes zero-span root segments, including segments that might only use constant output.
prototype0.evaluation: Frame + ((payload.float144 * 60) / payload.float152), checked after each Float32 operation. Constant/linear/Hermite modes, mode3 zero, native pre/post branches and repeated wrapping; native short rotation-span discontinuity guard.
prototype0.composition: Identity, row-vector X then Y then Z rotations, add XYZ translation, multiply every component of basis rows0..2 by channel scale. Native angle normalization is bounded and checked for progress. MathF sin/cos are not promised bit-identical to the game CRT.

raw1.rootMatrixOffset: UInt32 payload+44; zero means no root/identity.
raw1.frameCount: Positive bounded signed Int32 payload+36; each matrix has16 finite Float32 values/64 bytes.
raw1.frameFields: Loop-end float+84, rate float+88, loop-next float+92.
raw1.evaluation: scaled=(frame*rate)/60 in Float32; signed truncation, first-frame clamps, and matching changes to scaled. Native fractions in(-1,0) remain negative. Loop-next truncates and clamps above to last frame; negative or invalid conversion is rejected.
raw1.interpolation: Fraction0 copies left. Otherwise native XYZ normalization/length tolerance, dot-product branch selection, four-component translation lerp, exact scale-bit fast path, six ordered normalize/cross branches, four-component scale application. Zero-length normalization retains the vector; a finite result does not establish an invertible basis.

limits.failure: Typed MotionPayloadException before an out-of-span access or unbounded iteration. Invalid caller limits use ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

ownership: Private copied arrays; public matrices expose only read-only collections. Parsing/evaluation performs no process-pointer access, native calls or file writes.
numericOperations: Multiply(left,right) checks the native row-vector matrix product including every intermediate. ScaleBasis(matrix,positiveScale) scales all four components of the first three rows and preserves translation. Neither operation selects an Actor branch or proves live attachment/resource ownership.
excluded: Skeletal/IK/extra channels, constructor fixups, whole BAR validity and complete native motion safety
Provider selection, disk-to-runtime binding, resource generation, actors, attachments and native writer ownership
Automatic Tiny/Giant reward, native Drive guard, process reads/writes and live game tests
Bit-identical CRT transcendental behavior, every possible SSE floating-point environment, invertibility and all future frame values
